app.title: Ancadeba Editor
app.intro: Preview a game from your editor workspace.
game.languageHelp: Language tag, for example en or nl. Leave empty for the saved choice or game's default. Restart the preview after changing it.
preview.heading: Preview
preview.startGame: Play from the start of the game
preview.unsaved: You have unsaved edits. The preview uses saved files and will not include these edits. Start the preview anyway?
repair.heading: Repair project
recovery.folderHelp: Open an existing folder whose game.json is missing. Use a workspace-relative path with / separators, or leave it blank for the workspace root. No files are written until you save a repair.
recovery.review: This draft uses the files still present. Review the game ID, title, version, startup scene, and resource references before checking and saving. If several asset catalogues, input files, or stylesheets exist, choose their references yourself. Original metadata cannot be recovered automatically. You can also paste a backup manifest instead.
repair.help: Fix the JSON or CSS below, then choose Check repair to preview the remaining project problems without saving. Save one file at a time; repairs can be undone. A project with remaining errors cannot be played or exported. For image problems, correct the asset catalogue or replace the image in Assets.
repair.valid: No project problems remain in this preview. Save repair to apply the correction.
repair.remaining: {count} project problems remain in this preview. You can save this file and continue repairing the others.
repair.saved: Repair saved. Review any remaining diagnostics or use Undo to restore the previous file.
repair.saveFirst: Save or discard this repair draft before selecting another file.
repair.reloaded: Latest saved files loaded; your repair text was kept. Compare it with Current saved source, then check the repair again.
repair.checkFailed: Could not check this repair. Review the source and project error message.
repair.saveFailed: Could not save this repair. Your draft has been kept; reload the latest project before retrying.
export.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. They will not be included in the export. Export the last saved version anyway? Cancel to return and save your changes.
export.building: Building the game from its saved workspace files…
preview.label: Game preview
preview.empty: Start the engine to preview the game.

project.duplicateHelp: Copy the open project's saved files and assets into a new folder, then open the copy. The copy has its own game ID. Unsaved edits are not included.
project.createHelp: Create a game with a start screen and an adventure scene.

project.emptyList: No games found in this workspace.

maps.heading: Maps
maps.paintHelp: Click or drag to paint with the selected terrain. Use arrow keys to move between tiles and Enter or Space to paint. Stripes mark blocked terrain; ● marks a player spawn. Coordinates start at 0.
maps.placeHelp: To use this map, add a map-view component to a scene and select this map there.
maps.references: Used in scenes: {scenes}. Keep their viewports within the map and their player spawns on walkable terrain.
maps.deleteConfirm: Delete map {id}? Maps used by scenes cannot be deleted. You can undo a successful deletion.
maps.cropConfirm: Reduce the map size? Tiles outside the new dimensions will be removed from this draft.
maps.fillConfirm: Replace every tile in this draft with {terrain}?
maps.saveFirst: Save or discard the map draft before switching maps or panels.
maps.invalidSize: Use positive whole dimensions with at most 65,536 tiles.
maps.invalidTerrain: Use a terrain ID with letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Reserved names are not allowed.
maps.lastTerrain: Keep at least one terrain type.
maps.replacementRequired: Choose another terrain type to replace tiles using the removed terrain.
maps.minimapHelp: Click to center the view. The outline marks the visible area. Arrows pan; Shift+arrows moves a page; Home/End visits corners; Enter returns to the grid.
maps.viewHelp: Zoom out to see more tiles or zoom in for detail. Turn on Pan map and drag to move the view, or drag with the middle mouse button in any tool. Pan buttons move one tile; Previous/Next moves one page. In Pan mode, arrow keys move the view. With grid focus, +/− zooms and 0 returns to 100%. Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zooms around the pointer. View changes do not edit the map.
maps.tilesetInUse: Remove or replace terrain image selections before removing this tileset.
maps.invalidTilesetId: Choose a unique tileset ID using letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
maps.tilesetHelp: Choose an image and its tile size, then click a tile below to assign it to the selected paint terrain. Transparent areas show the terrain's base color. Turn off Use base color for image-only tiles. Coordinates start at 0.
maps.importHelp: Import an image in Assets first, then add a tileset here. PNG and WebP support transparent overlays.
maps.fillLayerConfirm: Fill every cell in {layer} with {terrain}? Other layers stay unchanged.
maps.clearLayerConfirm: Clear all objects from layer {layer}? Ground and other layers stay unchanged.
maps.removeLayerConfirm: Remove layer {layer} and all its objects?
maps.invalidLayer: Choose a layer ID using letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
maps.layerLimit: A map supports up to 32 overlay layers.
maps.layerHelp: Ground is always at the bottom. Overlay layers draw in the listed order; Move layer up draws it above other objects. Empty cells show the layers below. Paint and Erase affect only the selected layer. Hidden layers are not drawn and do not affect movement; show a layer before painting. Turn off Layer affects movement for decorations. The player appears above all layers.
maps.copyReady: Copied {width} × {height}. Click a destination to paste; paste again to reuse it.
maps.moveReady: Move ready: {width} × {height}. Source tiles stay in place until you paste at a valid destination.
maps.selectionHelp: Choose Select tiles and drag a rectangle on the active layer. Shift-click or Shift+arrow keys extends it; Enter selects a tile. Ctrl/Cmd+C copies, X cuts, and V prepares paste while the grid has focus. Click or press Enter to paste at the top-left destination. Escape cancels a pending move or clears the selection. The clipboard stays within this map; saving commits your edits.
maps.invalidSelection: Select a valid rectangle within the active layer first.
maps.pasteOutsideMap: The entire copied group must fit inside the map. Choose another destination.
maps.clipboardTerrainMissing: A copied terrain type no longer exists. Copy the group again.
maps.cutSourceChanged: The cut source changed. Select and cut the group again before moving it.
maps.invalidGroundFill: Choose an existing replacement terrain for ground tiles. Ground cannot contain empty cells.
localization.heading: Localization
metadata.translationHelp: Choose keys saved in Localization. Leave a key empty to use literal text. Missing language translations use the default-language text.
metadata.unknownKey: Unknown translation key. Create and save it in Localization, or choose an existing key.
metadata.emptyTitleTranslation: Title translations must not be empty. Choose a title key with non-empty text in every provided translation.
stylesheets.heading: Stylesheet
stylesheets.help: Edit CSS scoped to the game viewport. Use .ancadeba-scene and .ancadeba-button selectors or --ge- theme variables. Imports, font-face rules and global at-rules are unsupported. Save and restart Play to see changes; exports include saved CSS.
stylesheets.valid: The browser accepts this scoped stylesheet.
stylesheets.saveFirst: Save or discard the stylesheet draft before changing files or assignments.
stylesheets.duplicate: A stylesheet with this path already exists. Select the saved file or choose a different path.
controls.mapViewFirst: Add an interactive map view with a player spawn in this scene first.
controls.itemActionHelp: The slot appears when a selected item supports this action. The inspect ID uses its existing inspection action.
controls.saveBarFirst: Save or discard the action-bar draft before switching scenes.
controls.selectScene: Select a game scene to configure its action bar.
controls.inputHelp: Physical key codes identify keyboard positions, such as KeyQ, Digit1, and ArrowUp. Save input changes before choosing new bindings for a slot.

combat.encounterExists: A combat encounter with this ID already exists. Choose a different ID.
combat.healthHelp: Before adding an encounter, declare two distinct numeric health fields with positive starting values in Rules (for example health = 40 and enemyHealth = 20). Select them below. Existing state values stay unchanged.
combat.saveFirst: Save or discard the combat draft first.
combat.chooseSceneAndHealth: Choose a game scene and two distinct positive health fields from Rules before adding an encounter.
combat.saveFirstCopy: Save or discard the combat draft before making a local copy.
combat.itemUseHelp: Available types: {types}. Shared abilities and statuses are included automatically; actor learned moves stay separate.
combat.librarySaveFirstSwitch: Save or discard the library draft before switching libraries.

graphic.appearanceHelp: Static values supply fallbacks for bindings. Visibility expects true or false, colors expect #rrggbb, palettes expect a preset name, and part bindings expect an allowed part ID (or empty text for none).
graphic.standaloneHelp: This stand-alone scene uses static appearance. Game-state bindings require a game scene.
definitions.invalidId: Choose a valid, unused identifier using letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
definitions.previewEmpty: Create or select a part or composition to preview it.
definitions.pendingSwitch: Add or clear the pending piece, layer, anchor, slot, color or palette before switching entries.
definitions.help: Edit parts and compositions together, then save. Layers run back to front. Markers show source attachment points on parts and destination anchors on compositions. Invalid drafts stay editable.
definitions.pendingSave: Add or clear pending identifiers before saving.
definitions.saveFirst: Save or discard the graphic definitions draft before changing assets.
controls.duplicateKeys: {name} contains duplicate keys. Each key can have one mapping.
controls.pendingContext: Add or clear the pending input context before saving.
controls.invalidContextId: Enter a unique context ID using letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
items.typesFirstActions: Add inventory item types before configuring their actions.
items.uniqueActionIds: Item action IDs must be unique.
items.saveActionsFirst: Save or discard the item-action draft before switching item types.
items.slotsFirst: Add equipment slots to an owner to make this item equippable.
items.invalidSlot: Use a unique slot ID and a nonempty slot name.
items.healthFirst: Create numeric health state in Rules before enabling a combat stat profile.
items.saveInventoryFirst: Save or discard the inventory draft before switching files.
items.pendingSlotSwitch: Add or clear the pending equipment slot before switching entries.
items.inventoryHelp: Create item types and owners, then add starting items. All entries in this inventory are saved together. Changes to starting items apply to new games; existing playthroughs keep their runtime inventory.
items.invalidEntryId: Choose a valid, unused entry ID.
items.typeAndOwnerFirst: Create an item type and an owner before adding starting items.

items.saveBeforeEditors: Save or discard the current inventory or item draft before switching editors.

items.panelFirst: Add an inventory panel to this scene first.

leveling.adjustHealth: Adjust health when maximum health grows

rules.inspectionHelp: To show results in the main text, have the action set a text state field and bind that field in a text component. Hiding inline inspection keeps the action available to the action bar.
rules.triggerSaveFirstTypes: Save or discard the trigger draft before switching item types.
rules.typesFirstInspection: Add inventory item types before linking an inspection.
rules.invalidActionId: Enter a unique action ID using letters, digits, dashes, or underscores
rules.pickupHelp: Choose existing inventory items and their destination owner. All items must transfer successfully before the action changes its state or log. Items already owned by the recipient cannot be collected again.
rules.saveFirstFiles: Save or discard this draft before switching rule files.
rules.idExists: Choose a rule ID that is not already listed.

graphic.selectHelp: Select a scene graphic or choose Add graphic in the scene explorer.
graphic.help: Edit this scene instance without changing the shared artwork. Choosing a different visual resets its appearance. Changing a slot part keeps compatible overrides and clears incompatible colors or palettes. Save to update the game preview.

bindings.help: Write {{name}} in text or a translation, then bind that name to a value. Gold is a numeric state field declared in Rules. Quest counters use their objective state fields. This preview uses authored starting values before actions run; other derived values are available during play.
bindings.staticOnly: Dynamic text bindings require a game scene. Text in this scene stays static.
bindings.invalidName: Enter an unused binding name using letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
bindings.playOnly: Some values are available only during play; fallback text is shown when provided.
bindings.fromLocalization: This template comes from Localization. Edit its placeholders there; every language uses these binding names.
component.pendingBinding: Add or clear the pending text binding before saving.
component.interactiveYes: Yes, the player moves on this map
drafts.available: A local recovery copy of unsaved drafts is available for this project.
drafts.restored: Unsaved drafts restored. Save each edited section when ready. Reselect any image file you were importing.
drafts.partial: Some drafts could not be restored. Their recovery copy was kept. Reselect any image file you were importing.
drafts.storageError: Local draft recovery is unavailable or full. Keep this tab open and save your changes.
drafts.replaceCurrent: Replace your current unsaved edits with the recovery copy?
maps.entryHelp: Run a Rules action after the player finishes stepping onto a tile. Coordinates start at 0. Spawn, scene return and loading a save do not trigger actions. Use action conditions for one-time events or scene-specific behavior.
maps.entryRuleFirst: Create and save an action in Rules before adding a tile-entry trigger.
entrance.help: Coordinates start at 0 and override this map view's remembered position. Arrival does not activate tile-entry triggers. Without coordinates, the player resumes their previous location or starts at the authored spawn.
maps.entryGridHelp: Click a tile to add or edit its trigger. Use arrow keys then Enter or Space for keyboard editing. New triggers require a walkable tile and a saved Rules action. Escape returns to painting. Dragging does not paint or create more triggers.
maps.entryGridLegend: T badges mark tile-entry triggers. Choose Edit tile-entry triggers above the grid to add or edit one on a tile.
maps.entryBlocked: Choose a walkable tile for a tile-entry trigger.
maps.objectHelp: Click a tile in Map objects mode to place or edit an object. O badges mark objects. Set a label, appearance terrain and saved Rules action. Appearance uses the terrain's color or image; Blocks movement controls collision separately. Players interact from a cardinally adjacent tile while stationary. Enter/Space opens a tile; Escape returns to painting.
maps.objectOutside: Choose a tile inside the map for this object.
maps.objectSpawn: Choose a tile away from player spawns for a new blocking object. You can make an object passable in its settings.
maps.interactHelp: Choose an object, or leave the target automatic. Automatic interaction requires exactly one cardinally adjacent object. When several are adjacent, click an object in the map or configure a specific target. Interaction is unavailable while moving.
maps.objectStatesHelp: The first state whose boolean Rules flag matches overrides the object's defaults during play. Choose an appearance, label, blocking or visibility override. Hidden objects cannot block movement or be interacted with. Blank labels inherit the default. The editor grid shows all objects with their default appearance, including hidden objects.
maps.objectFlagFirst: Create and save a boolean state field in Rules before adding an object state.
combat.mechanics.heading: Resources, triggers and phases
combat.mechanics.rotations: Enemy rotations (comma-separated move IDs; empty uses default)
combat.mechanics.moveFilter: Move filter (action/effect events; empty matches all)
combat.rulesets.heading: Reusable combat rulesets
combat.rulesets.selectHelp: Select a shared ruleset to use its mechanics. Selecting one replaces the inline mechanics in this draft.
combat.rulesets.inheritHelp: Edit the effective mechanics below to change this encounter only. Unchanged fields continue to inherit library updates. Choosing inline mechanics detaches a copy.
combat.rulesets.title: Ruleset: {id}
combat.status.modifier.ap: AP budget modifier per stack and intensity
combat.status.modifier.apCost: Action AP cost modifier per stack and intensity
combat.ai.heading: Conditional enemy AI
combat.ai.help: Rules run from top to bottom; all conditions must match. Enemies choose again before each action. Unavailable moves are skipped. Empty conditions always match; absent statuses count as zero.
combat.aiProfiles.heading: Reusable enemy AI profiles
combat.aiProfiles.title: AI profile: {id}
combat.aiProfiles.applyActors: Apply AI actor roles to controls
combat.aiProfiles.profileHelp: Self always means the enemy using this profile. Bind other actor roles in each encounter. Resource and phase IDs are checked against the encounter; moves and statuses come from this library.
combat.aiProfiles.inheritHelp: Self binds to this enemy. Edit the effective rules to save only local changes. Untouched rules follow the shared profile.
combat.simulation.heading: Combat simulation and debugging
combat.simulation.help: Test combat moves using the current encounter draft, saved libraries, starting fields and equipped bonuses. This sandbox does not change the game or documents. Item use, rewards and world progression are outside this test. Starting conditions apply on Start/reset.
combat.simulation.changed: Encounter data changed. Start/reset the simulation to test the updated draft.
combat.simulation.priorityHelp: Rules below the first executable match are not evaluated. Previews reserve costs without predicting future gains or effects.
combat.simulation.truncated: The trace limit was reached. The report still includes all round inputs and final state.
combat.scenarios.heading: Saved combat scenarios
combat.scenarios.help: Save starting conditions and scripted rounds as a named test in this encounter. Replay uses the current encounter draft and saved libraries. Edit starting conditions in the simulator, then capture them here. Checks after a step run after its repeats. Expected results change only when you edit or explicitly capture them.
combat.scenarios.rerun: Test inputs changed. Replay to verify again.
combat.scenarios.saveFirst: Save or discard the scenario draft first.
combat.scenarios.name: Scenario name
combat.scenarios.runFirst: Run a simulation before capturing expected state.
combat.composition.heading: Composed combat rulesets
combat.composition.help: Layers run in order; encounter overrides apply last. Duplicate IDs require explicit replacement. Any objective ruleset keeps trigger-based victory active.
combat.scaling.help: Add weighted resource, status, health, missing-health, stat or round values to the base, or apply their sum as a percentage. Values are evaluated from current combat state. Status stat formulas read pre-status stats to avoid recursion.
combat.scaling.actor: Scaling actor (self, target, or actor ID)
combat.damage.heading: Damage defenses
combat.damage.help: Resistance subtracts and vulnerability adds percentage points to damage, after flat defense and before Guard. Immunity overrides both. Status percentages scale with stacks and intensity. Types are matching IDs; omitted attack types use physical.
combat.events.formulaHelp: Amount = base amount + event value × factor. Actual amount is HP changed after mitigation and health limits. Reactions ignore other reactions unless explicitly enabled.
combat.events.field.rawAmount: Amount before mitigation or health limit
combat.restrictions.heading: Status immunity and action restrictions
combat.restrictions.help: Status immunities block new applications, refreshes and added stacks by status ID; existing statuses remain until removed or expired. Blocked categories prevent matching moves. Silence typically blocks spell; disarm blocks weapon. Categories are explicit matching IDs, with no inferred defaults. Active statuses add protections until they expire.
equipment.combat.heading: Equipped defenses and mechanics
equipment.combat.help: Only equipped instances contribute these effects to their linked combat-stat owner. Positive gains of an actor-owned resource add flat modifiers, then additive percentage modifiers, rounding down. Sets, payments and recovery losses are unchanged. Unmatched resource/status IDs are inert in other encounters. Shared granted moves must be valid for the owner’s linked encounters. Loadouts remain locked during unfinished combat.
combat.requirements.heading: Action requirements
combat.requirements.help: All requirements must match before an action can be queued and before it resolves. Reserved costs reduce available resources; queued effects are not predicted. Use AND/OR/NOT, status strength, resource percentages or boss phases.
combat.passives.heading: Shared combat passives
combat.passives.help: Passives grant reusable triggers while equipment is worn or a status is active. self is the bearer. Type encounter resource/phase IDs; once-only triggers keep their history per granting item/status for this encounter. Status stacks and intensity do not multiply triggers.
combat.passives.title: Passive: {id}
combat.triggerLimits.help: Higher priorities run first across encounter and passive triggers. Ties keep source order. Charges last for this encounter and each granting source has its own limits. Per-turn counts reset at each combatant turn start. Cooldown skips the next N rounds. Matching triggers spend their activation before effects run; Once still permits at most one activation.
